This is a legal condition that must be included and resolved before I can recommend approval for the October 1 external availability date.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical regulatory condition before final authorization. My intended-use review concluded that the planned language describing automated clinical triage recommendations makes diagnostic claims, which would subject the platform to medical device regulation. The launch materials must instead describe the product as an administrative workflow tool only, with no diagnostic or triage recommendation claims. I have not yet circulated this review or updated the product-description template in the launch packet accordingly. This is a legal condition that must be included and resolved before I can recommend approval for the October 1 external availability date.
